title: Syd2 G10x + BurstCommit+ Launch Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Coordinate a cross-functional launch for Dedicated capacity in the new APAC region 'syd2' (ap-southeast-4) that introduces the G10x-Accelerant instance family and a new reservation product, BurstCommit+.

Scope: (1) product definition and pricing for G10x SKUs, (2) implementation and docs for BurstCommit+ (burstable committed capacity with tiered overage pricing), (3) release notes and customer communications, (4) Console + API support for region selector and new SKU mapping, (5) billing backend updates and invoice mapping, (6) telemetry and SLO baselines for initial cohorts.

Success metrics (first 90 days): onboard 5k reserved vCPU-hours via BurstCommit+, <2% billing disputes for new SKUs, p50 latency within target for top 10 customers in region, and observability dashboards with token-level cost breakdown for G10x.

Stakeholders: Marcus Chen (Eng lead), Tomás Müller (Design), Elena Rodriguez (Sales lead APAC), Priya Nair (Legal & Compliance), Ben Carter (Customer Success), Ravi Kapoor (Billing), SRE oncall rotation ENG-ops.

Key decisions so far: BurstCommit+ will support automatic burst for up to 2x committed baseline for 5-minute sustained periods; overage pricing uses a fixed multiplier and will be clearly surfaced in the Console and invoices. We will not offer cross-region automatic failover for initial launch (opt-in later).

2026-03-05 — Design review: Tomás provided Console flows for reservation purchase and SKU selector (Figma link in links). Design requested an additional confirmation modal for Billing terms.

acceptance_criteria: API: reservation purchase endpoint accepts region=ap-southeast-4 and sku=g10x-*. Documentation updated.
Console: SKU selector and confirmation modal implemented and reviewed by Design.
Billing: invoice line-item for BurstCommit+ presentable with prorate scenarios and test coverage.
Telemetry: per-route token cost and p50/p95 latency dashboards populated for region syd2.
Docs/Release Notes: final release notes reviewed by PM, Eng, Legal and scheduled for publish at release date.
rollout_steps: Step 1 — Hard launch to internal canary customers (3 pilot customers) with feature flag enabled.
Step 2 — Monitor telemetry for 72 hours; validate p50/p95 latency and abnormal billing spikes.
Step 3 — Open GA purchase for all customers in syd2; publish release notes and cohort email.
Step 4 — 2-week observations window; maintain on-call watch and prepare patch plan if >5% SLA alerts or >2% unexpected billing disputes.
Step 5 — Post-launch retrospective and adoption playbook (90-day review).
rollback_plan: If critical latency regressions or systemic billing errors are detected during canary: (a) disable BurstCommit+ purchases via feature flag, (b) revert SKU mapping change in API gateway, (c) route new incoming requests to compatible older instance family (g9x-compat) for a soft failover, (d) notify customers and begin patch rollout. Engineering and SRE will own fixes and incremental re-enablement.
notes: Tradeoffs: Opting to ship BurstCommit+ with fixed overage multiplier simplifies billing calculations but may undercapture revenue from customers who frequently burst; we will revisit dynamic pricing in Q3 if adoption warrants.

Open question: Should we permit customers to convert existing reservations to BurstCommit+ with prorated credit? Requirement from Sales but increases billing complexity—Ravi to propose two migration flows by 2026-03-16.
Follow-ups: Create GH checklist for end-to-end invoice generation tests, include legal-approved copy in Console UI, prepare Sales one-pager and customer FAQ.
